{{Top|leg}}
'''Bark lizards''' were reptiles native to [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. Though they were edible for [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]], the creatures gave [[Human/Legends|Humans]] a rash. They fed off of bark.
